items.title: Argentina's bid to stop Falklands oil drilling rejected
items.description: A joint venture between UK-Israeli companies is set to start exploring for oil and gas, but Argentina sought to block it as part of its claim to sovereignty.

items.title: Two staff killed in Israeli strike on Gaza medical clinic, MSF says
items.description: The Israeli military says it targeted "Hamas terrorists" in the strike which has been condemned by the World Health Organization.

items.title: Afghanistan explosion kills 10 students and injures more than 100, official says
items.description: A spokesman for Afghanistan's interior ministry says the blast was caused by carelessness at an explosives depot nearby.

items.title: Spanish PM and rivals rally supporters in final pitch for votes
items.description: Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez wants to defy the polls, and his main rivals accuse him of not telling the truth and of "betrayal".

items.title: OpenAI counter-sues Apple over alleged theft of trade secrets
items.description: The ChatGPT-maker alleges that tech giant Apple stole trade secrets through a former employee.

items.title: Eight killed in Peruvian military helicopter crash
items.description: The pilot was the sole survivor of the crash during a rescue mission in a remote area known for drug trafficking.

items.title: Australian wrestler Bronson Reed dies aged 38, WWE says
items.description: Tributes have flooded in for the 38-year-old Australian who is survived by his pregnant wife, Paige, their daughter.

items.title: 'Poison seller' Kenneth Law apologises in court to the families of his victims
items.description: The Canadian man, who pleaded guilty to 14 counts of aiding and abetting suicide earlier this year, said he was remorseful for his actions.

items.title: Turkish officials 'destroyed' pro-opposition TV channel, owner tells BBC
items.description: The headquarters of Halk TV were raided last month, the latest in a series of crackdowns on news sources deemed critical of the government.

items.title: Zelensky criticises 'strange' Trump-Putin friendship in BBC interview
items.description: Ukraine's president voices frustration with US and says it is not pushing Russia hard enough in peace talks to end the war.

items.title: 'We couldn't give up that easily': Marching bands scramble to cover costs after Thanksgiving parade rearranged
items.description: Stormy weather in New York City prompted organisers to push back the Macy's parade by two days - leaving some musicians stuck.

items.title: Canada's top court largely upholds Quebec ban on religious symbols for public servants
items.description: The law faced legal challenges from a range of groups, including female Muslim, Sikh and Catholic teachers, who argued it violated their fundamental rights.
